title: Milo and the Little Garden Rescue
subtitle: A Gentle Storybook Adventure
description: Join Milo the rabbit, Pip the bird, and Grandma Turtle as they fix a leaking watering can and learn how to care for drooping flowers.

segments.label: The Drooping Flower
segments.description: Milo discovers a drooping flower next to a leaking watering can.

segments.label: Fixing the Watering Can
segments.description: Milo crosses the wooden bridge to Grandma's toolbox and patches the leak with tape.

segments.label: The Mystery Sound & Grandma's Lesson
segments.description: Following footprints through the red gate, Milo learns the 3 rules of garden care.

segments.label: Look, Think, Help
segments.description: Applying Grandma's advice, Milo waters the flower and watches it recover at sunset.

interactions.prompt: Tap the flower that looks unwell
interactions.description: Select the drooping flower among the healthy ones nearby.

hotspots.label: Drooping Flower
hotspots.info: This flower's leaves are hanging low — it needs help!

interactions.prompt: Hold to tip the watering can and see what happens
interactions.description: Hold to tip the watering can and reveal the leak.

interactions.prompt: Trace Milo's steps across the wooden bridge
interactions.description: Follow the bridge path to reach Grandma's toolbox.

interactions.prompt: Grandma's toolbox has tape, ribbon, and a cloth — drag the one that can fix a leak into the watering can
interactions.description: Drag the blue tape to patch the hole.

items.label: Ribbon 🎀
items.description: Pretty ribbon, but won't stop water.

items.label: Cloth 🧹
items.description: Soft cloth, but water passes through.

interactions.prompt: Look carefully — which of the three flowers needs help?

hotspots.label: Yellow Drooping Flower
hotspots.info: Correct! This flower is drooping and needs care.

hotspots.label: Pink Healthy Flower
hotspots.info: This flower is healthy and blooming.

hotspots.label: Orange Healthy Flower
hotspots.info: This flower has plenty of sunlight and water.

interactions.prompt: Follow the big footprints to find out who they belong to
interactions.description: Trace along the large turtle footprints toward the clearing.

interactions.prompt: Put Grandma's advice in the right order: Look, Think, Help
interactions.description: Assemble the three steps in sequence.

pieces.label: Look 👀
pieces.description: 1st: Look carefully at what the garden needs

pieces.label: Think 🤔
pieces.description: 2nd: Think about how to solve the problem

interactions.prompt: Hold to pour water on the soil and watch the flower recover
interactions.description: Hold to water the plant until it blooms again.

assessment.instructions: Answer the following questions about Milo's garden rescue story.

levels.label: Recall & Understand
levels.description: Test your recall of key story details.

items.question: What was wrong with Milo's watering can?
options: It had a small hole and was leaking
items.explanation: Milo's watering can had a small hole and was leaking water.

items.question: According to Grandma Turtle, what three things does a garden need?
items.explanation: Grandma Turtle taught that a garden needs sunlight, water, and care.

levels.label: Apply
levels.description: Apply Grandma's lesson to new situations.

items.question: If you saw a houseplant at home with drooping leaves, what should you do first — before immediately watering it?
options: Look carefully to figure out what's actually wrong first
Pour as much water as possible right away
Move it outside in the wind
items.explanation: Grandma Turtle's rule is to Look first to see what the plant actually needs.

items.question: Arrange Grandma's advice in the correct order.
items.explanation: Grandma's 3-step advice sequence is: Look → Think → Help.
